title: Introduce RAG lint-garden: interactive linting playground and compact CLI walkthrough
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: developers iterating on RAG toolchains repeatedly encounter flaky tool-calling behavior and subtle prompt-schema regressions. The lint-garden quickstart provides an interactive playground for linting agent tool-calls against a small suite of policy and structured-output checks, plus a compact CLI walkthrough so teams can run the same checks in CI locally.

What this PR adds: one self-contained quickstart (quickstarts/rag-lint-garden) and complementary docs site integration. The quickstart includes: an embeddable web sandbox (static HTML + wasm shim), a compact Python CLI that runs lint rules and smoke scenarios, sample prompt/tool contracts, and telemetry snippets (SDK hooks and sample traces) to highlight failure modes.

Goals: make early-stage RAG debugging easier, provide reproducible lint rules that can be run in CI, and ship a docs page with live snippets so the site can render an in-page sandbox.

Checklist:
- [x] quickstart README with step-by-step local run
- [x] compact CLI (pip-installable in dev) with `lint` and `simulate` commands
- [x] sample tool contracts + structured-output examples
- [x] docs site page and embedded sandbox snippet
- [x] unit smoke tests and CI job for quickstart
- [x] telemetry snippets (tracing + token-cost probe)

Usage highlights (copied for reviewers):
1) Run the sandbox locally (dev):
   git clone --depth 1 .../redwood-quickstarts && cd quickstarts/rag-lint-garden
   make dev-sandbox # starts an http server and wasm shim
2) Run CLI lint (local CI):
   python -m rgcli lint --rules ./rules/default.yaml --scenarios ./scenarios/smoke.json
3) Simulate a failing tool call and upload trace (dev only):
   python -m rgcli simulate --scenario failing_tool_call.json --trace-out ./trace.json

Docs integration: new docs/playbooks/rag-linting.md describes the lint rule format and links to the quickstart. site/snippets/lint-garden-embed.html provides an iframe-friendly static embed; the docs site can include the snippet via an include. The PR includes short copy and live snippet manifest so the site CI will render the sandbox in the docs preview.

Compatibility and scope: this quickstart is intentionally lightweight. It relies on the existing RAG tool contract primitives in the examples package and the Redwood SDK v0.7+ APIs. No breaking API changes. The telemetry snippets are opt-in and only added to demo runner code, not to core SDKs.

Testing notes: initial CI run surfaced a flaky wasm shim load in Chrome Headless; fixed by deferring iframe init until assets ready and added a small retry in the test harness. All tests now pass on linux/amd64 CI matrix.
